source: docs/spec/07_multitenancy_reconfiguration.md#2. Tenant onboarding checklist (what the AI must produce)

steps.title: Tenant record
steps.produce: Name, currency, base and target year, ticker, fiscal calendar.
research: Legal name, stock ticker and reporting currency
Fiscal calendar and the last reported fiscal year

steps.title: Baseline lines
steps.produce: Each line mapped to a canonical pool, a domain, an addressability tag and a scale driver, with amount and capex share. Where no bottom-up data exists, build an outside-in baseline from benchmarks x headcount x footprint, every line with source and confidence.
research: IT footprint: data centres, cloud use, application portfolio, key platforms
IT spend benchmarks for carriers of a similar size

steps.title: Org
steps.produce: Technology VPs and domain ownership (each domain's shares sum to 100%), and the shared-services owner.
research: Technology leadership structure and who owns which domains

steps.title: Workforce
steps.produce: Internal, captive and contractor headcount, and the headcounts the baseline lines were sized at.

steps.title: Vendors
steps.produce: Preferred vendor panel and book of business.
research: IT outsourcing, managed-service and consulting vendors

steps.title: Corporate drivers
steps.produce: Last reported year as calibration targets from the annual report (revenue, fuel, SWB, opex, EBIT, interest, net income, OCF, FCF, cash, net debt), plus forecasts for the next two years. Labor groups follow the airline's own unions.
research: Annual report figures: revenue, fuel, SWB, opex, EBIT, interest, net income, OCF, FCF, cash, net debt
Capacity, yield, load factor and fleet

steps.title: Target
steps.produce: Dollar amount or % of base, growth absorption, one-time funding share.

steps.title: Scenarios
steps.produce: Copy the five global presets; lever inputs stay the library defaults until tuned.

steps.title: Sources
steps.produce: Every value carries source and confidence.
